d_en: DOMa records this commercial building at 234 Olympionikon Street in Neo Psychiko as a 1974 design by Ioannis Vikelas.
k: AB Shop in Psychiko; Κατάστημα ΑΒ στο Νέο Ψυχικό
d_it: DOMa registra questo edificio commerciale al numero 234 di via Olympionikon a Neo Psychiko come progetto del 1974 di Ioannis Vikelas.

n: Former AGET Iraklis Headquarters at 92 Sofokli Venizelou Avenue
d: ライコブリシにある旧AGET Iraklis本社を改修したオフィス建築。コンクリート外装を修復し、内部空間を再構成した計画で、設計者資料は2021年完成としている。
d_en: Completed in 2021, this former AGET Iraklis headquarters in Lykovrisi was renovated as offices, with its concrete façade restored and interiors reorganized.
rn: 元の建築設計: Alexandros N. Tombazis。資料間で原建物完成年は1972年と1975年、改修完了年は2020年と2021年の記録があり「要確認」に記載。
rn_en: Original building design: Alexandros N. Tombazis. Sources differ on original completion (1972 or 1975) and renovation completion (2020 or 2021); see 要確認.
k: Former AGET Iraklis Headquarters; ΑΓΕΤ Ηρακλής - Κτήριο διοίκησης
d_it: Completata nel 2021, questa ex sede di AGET Iraklis a Lykovrisi è stata ristrutturata come uffici, con la facciata in calcestruzzo restaurata e gli interni riorganizzati.

d: 1846年に着工したアルサキオン複合建築は、1925年までに街区全体へ拡張され、商業回廊となった。現在は店舗、文化施設、教育施設などが入る。
d_en: The Arsakeio complex grew from 1846 to 1925 into a block-wide arcade. It now contains shops, cultural venues and educational spaces.
k: Arsakeio Megaro; Stoa Arsakeiou; Στοά Αρσακείου
d_it: Il complesso dell'Arsakeio crebbe dal 1846 al 1925 fino a diventare una galleria grande quanto un isolato. Oggi comprende negozi, sedi culturali e spazi educativi.

addr: Vasilissis Sofias Avenue at Irodotou Street, Athens, Greece
d: エルンスト・ツィラー設計の新古典主義邸宅。現在はキクラデス美術館の企画展会場として使われ、建築見学も一般に公開されている。
d_en: Ernst Ziller completed this neoclassical mansion in 1895. It now hosts temporary Museum of Cycladic Art exhibitions and welcomes architecture visitors.
d_it: Ernst Ziller completò questa villa neoclassica nel 1895. Oggi ospita mostre temporanee del Museo di Arte Cicladica e accoglie i visitatori interessati all'architettura.

n: Old Palace at Paparrigopoulou 7 (Athens City Museum)
d: 1834年完成の邸宅で、設計はグスタフ＝アドルフ・リューダースとヨーゼフ・ホッファー。オットー王夫妻の仮王宮を経て、現在はアテネ市博物館の一棟として公開される。
d_en: Built for Stamatios Dekozi-Vouros in 1834, the house briefly served King Otto and Queen Amalia. It now forms part of Athens City Museum.
n_el: Μουσείο της πόλεως των Αθηνών (Ίδρυμα Βούρου-Ευταξία)
d_it: Costruita per Stamatios Dekozi-Vouros nel 1834, la casa servì brevemente il re Ottone e la regina Amalia. Oggi fa parte del Museo della Città di Atene.

s: 古典主義・ロマン主義
d: スタマティス・クレアンティス設計のヴィラ・イリシアは1848年完成。現在はビザンティン・キリスト教博物館として使われ、博物館公式情報で一般公開と開館時間を確認できる。
d_en: Stamatis Kleanthis designed this 1848 residence for the Duchess of Plaisance. The villa now houses the Byzantine and Christian Museum.
k: Villa Ilissia; Ilissia; Βυζαντινό και Χριστιανικό Μουσείο
d_it: Stamatis Kleanthis progettò questa residenza del 1848 per la duchessa di Plaisance. La villa ospita oggi il Museo Bizantino e Cristiano.

d: エルンスト・ツィラー設計の邸宅を文化省が2018年に修復し、2021年にロヴェルドス博物館として公開。館内では後期ビザンティン美術の収蔵品を展示する。
d_en: Restored by the Ministry of Culture in 2018, the mansion opened as the Loverdos Museum in 2021 with a post-Byzantine religious art collection.
rn: 原設計: Ernst Ziller (1882–1885)。1930年の博物館転用・増築: Aristotelis Zachos。2018年の修復設計者は出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Original design: Ernst Ziller (1882–1885). Museum conversion and additions in 1930: Aristotelis Zachos. The cited source does not state the architect for the 2018 restoration.
k: Ziller-Loverdos Mansion; Loverdos Museum; Μέγαρο Τσίλλερ-Λοβέρδου
d_it: Restaurata dal Ministero della Cultura nel 2018, la villa ha aperto nel 2021 come Museo Loverdos con una collezione di arte religiosa postbizantina.

addr: Dexippou Street & Taxiarchon Street, Plaka, Athens, Greece
d: 1922年に再建されたプラカの教会で、ネオビザンティン様式の交差式ドームを持つ。1995年に西側が小規模に増築され、現在は巡礼地として案内されている。
d_en: Rebuilt in 1922, this Plaka church has a domed, cross-in-square plan. A small western extension followed in 1995; the site remains a pilgrimage destination.
k: Panagia Grigorousa; Church of Pammegistoi Taxiarches; Παναγία Γρηγορούσα
d_it: Ricostruita nel 1922, questa chiesa della Plaka ha una pianta a croce inscritta con cupola. Un piccolo ampliamento a ovest seguì nel 1995; il sito resta meta di pellegrinaggio.

n: GAIA Centre for Environmental Research and Education
addr: 100 Othonos Street & 13 Levidou Street, Kifisia, Greece
d: キフィシアの自然史博物館に接続する環境研究・教育施設。Michael Photiadis Associate Architectsが設計し、1997〜2000年に建設、2000年に完成した。
d_en: Michael Photiadis Associate Architects designed this Kifissia environmental research centre, built from 1997 to 2000 as part of the natural history museum.
d_it: Michael Photiadis Associate Architects progettarono questo centro di ricerca ambientale di Kifissia, costruito tra il 1997 e il 2000 come parte del museo di storia naturale.

d: イオアニス・ラザリモス設計の劇場建築で、1895年に開場。大規模修復後の2013年に公演を再開し、現在もピレウス市立劇場として使われる。
d_en: Designed by Ioannis Lazarimos and opened in 1895, this theatre resumed performances after a 2013 restoration and remains Piraeus’s municipal theatre.
rn: 改修完了・再開: 2013年。原設計: Ioannis Lazarimos、開場1895年。改修設計者は引用出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Restored and reopened in 2013. Original design: Ioannis Lazarimos; opened in 1895. The cited source does not identify the restoration architect.
k: Piraeus Municipal Theatre; Δημοτικό Θέατρο Πειραιά
d_it: Progettato da Ioannis Lazarimos e inaugurato nel 1895, questo teatro ha ripreso le rappresentazioni dopo il restauro del 2013 ed è il teatro municipale del Pireo.

n: Strigos Mansion (Aikaterini Laskaridis Foundation Historical Library)
addr: 36 2nd Merarchias Avenue & Aktis Moutsopoulou, Piraeus 185 35, Greece
d: ストリンゴス邸は1917年にゲオルギオス・ストリンゴスが取得・居住した邸宅。2006年に全面改修され、現在はアイクァテリニ・ラスカリディス財団の歴史図書館の一部として公開されている。
d_en: Georgios Stringos acquired this mansion in 1917 and lived there. Renovated in 2006, it now houses part of the Aikaterini Laskaridis Foundation library.
rn: 全面改修完了: 2006年。元の竣工年および原設計者・改修設計者は引用した財団資料に記載なし。
rn_en: Complete renovation: 2006. The cited Foundation source does not state the original completion year, original architect, or renovation architect.
d_it: Georgios Stringos acquistò questa villa nel 1917 e vi abitò. Ristrutturata nel 2006, ospita oggi parte della biblioteca della Fondazione Aikaterini Laskaridis.

n: Vassaneio Megaro (Hellenic Naval Academy Main Building)
d: 1900年に建設が始まり、1904年に完成した海軍士官学校の本館。ピレウス市の建築案内はエルンスト・ツィラーの設計として記録し、同校は現在もこの敷地を使用している。
d_en: Construction began in 1900 and was completed in 1904. Piraeus’s municipal architecture guide credits Ernst Ziller; the Naval Academy continues to use the site.
d_it: I lavori iniziarono nel 1900 e si conclusero nel 1904. La guida di architettura municipale del Pireo attribuisce il progetto a Ernst Ziller; l'Accademia Navale continua a utilizzare il sito.

n: Old Post Office of Piraeus (Municipal Art Gallery)
d: ピレウス初の専用郵便局として1901年に完成した二階建て建築。八角形の中央ホールを持ち、2005年以降はピレウス市立美術館として使われている。
d_en: Completed in 1901 as Greece’s first purpose-built post office, this civic building has housed the Municipal Art Gallery of Piraeus since 2005.
k: Municipal Art Gallery of Piraeus; Old Post Office; Παλαιό Ταχυδρομείο Πειραιά
d_it: Completato nel 1901 come primo ufficio postale costruito appositamente in Grecia, questo edificio civico ospita dal 2005 la Pinacoteca Municipale del Pireo.

d: 1966年に開館したピレウスの考古学博物館。ゼア港近くに位置し、ミケーネ時代からローマ時代までの遺物を展示する。
d_en: Opened in 1966 near the port of Zea, the museum displays finds spanning the Mycenaean era to Roman times and documents the history of ancient Piraeus.
k: Archaeological Museum of Piraeus; Αρχαιολογικό Μουσείο Πειραιά
d_it: Aperto nel 1966 vicino al porto di Zea, il museo espone reperti dall'età micenea all'epoca romana e documenta la storia dell'antico Pireo.

n: Dimotiki Scholi (74th Primary School of Athens)
d: 1876年完成の旧市立学校で、現在はアテネ第74小学校として使われる。Panagiotis Kalkosの設計で、ドーリア式の柱とペディメントを備えた入口が特徴。
d_en: Designed by Panagiotis Kalkos in 1876, this former municipal school still houses Athens’s 74th Primary School. Its entrance has Doric columns and a pediment.
k: Municipal School; 74th Primary School of Athens; Δημοτική Σχολή
d_it: Progettato da Panagiotis Kalkos nel 1876, questo ex edificio scolastico municipale ospita ancora la 74ª scuola elementare di Atene. L'ingresso ha colonne doriche e un frontone.

u: スタジアム・スポーツ
addr: Ethnarhou Makariou Avenue 1, Neo Faliro, Piraeus 185 47, Greece
d: 1984年に完成した多目的屋内競技場。鋼製ケーブルの屋根構造を持ち、現在もスポーツ大会や文化行事の会場として使われる。
d_en: Completed in 1984, this multipurpose indoor arena is distinguished by its cable-net roof. It remains an active venue for sporting and cultural events.
k: SEF; Στάδιο Ειρήνης και Φιλίας; Stadio Eirinis kai Philias
d_it: Completato nel 1984, questo palazzetto polivalente coperto si distingue per il tetto a rete di cavi. Resta una sede attiva per eventi sportivi e culturali.

addr: 26 Panepistimiou Street & 2 Sina Street, Athens 106 72, Greece
d: 1847年に着工し、1869年に完成した眼科病院。現在も外来診療や救急医療を行い、2014年に修復された歴史的建物へ戻って診療を続けている。
d_en: Completed in 1869, the eye hospital returned to its restored historic building in 2014, where it continues outpatient and emergency care.
d_it: Completato nel 1869, l'ospedale oculistico è tornato nel 2014 nel suo edificio storico restaurato, dove continua a offrire assistenza ambulatoriale e di pronto soccorso.

d: フランス文化院の建物群は1952–53年にLeonidas Bonisが設計し、1970年代にDemosthenes Molfessisらによる棟が加わった。現在は在ギリシャ・フランス大使館の文化・教育機関として運営される。
d_en: Founded in a 1952–53 building by Leonidas Bonis, the institute gained a wing in the 1970s. It now provides France’s cultural and educational services in Greece.
k: Institut français de Grèce; Γαλλικό Ινστιτούτο Ελλάδος
d_it: Fondato in un edificio del 1952–53 di Leonidas Bonis, l'istituto ottenne un'ala negli anni Settanta. Oggi offre in Grecia i servizi culturali ed educativi della Francia.

addr: Leonidou & Myllerou Streets, Metaxourgeio, Athens 104 36, Greece
d: Christian Hansen設計の旧製糸工場をアテネ市が修復し、2010年から市立美術館として使用。現在はギリシャ美術家の作品を中心とする展示施設となっている。
d_en: Christian Hansen’s former silk factory became an art gallery after restoration. Since 2010 it has shown Greek art in permanent and temporary exhibitions.
rn: 原設計: Christian Hansen。市による修復後、2010年から市立美術館として使用。修復設計者は引用資料に記載なし。
rn_en: Original design: Christian Hansen. The restored complex has housed the municipal gallery since 2010. The cited sources do not name the restoration architect.
k: Municipal Gallery of Athens; Old Silk Mill; Δημοτική Πινακοθήκη Αθηνών
d_it: L'ex fabbrica della seta di Christian Hansen è diventata una galleria d'arte dopo il restauro. Dal 2010 presenta arte greca in mostre permanenti e temporanee.

n: Kyriakoulis Mavromichalis Residence (European Parliament Liaison Office)
addr: 8 Vasilissis Amalias Avenue & Xenofontos Street, Athens 105 57, Greece
d: 1870年頃にTheophil Hansenが設計した邸宅。1999年の地震被害を受けて2004–2007年に修復され、現在は欧州議会ギリシャ代表部が入る。
d_en: Designed around 1870 by Theophil Hansen, the mansion was restored after the 1999 earthquake. It now houses the European Parliament’s delegation in Greece.
rn: 原設計: Theophil Hansen。地震被害後、2004–2007年にNikos Chatzikyriakou / Grigoris Chatzidimitriouの設計で修復。
rn_en: Original design: Theophil Hansen. Following earthquake damage, the residence was restored from 2004 to 2007 to designs by Nikos Chatzikyriakou and Grigoris Chatzidimitriou.
k: Kyriakoulis Mavromihalis Residence; Mavromichalis Mansion; Οικία Κυριακούλη Μαυρομιχάλη
d_it: Progettato intorno al 1870 da Theophil Hansen, il palazzo è stato restaurato dopo il terremoto del 1999. Oggi ospita la delegazione del Parlamento europeo in Grecia.

addr: 93 Aiolou Street & 1 Kratinou Street, Athens 105 51, Greece
d: エルンスト・ツィラー設計の旧郵便局は1874年に完成し、建物外殻は1979年に修復された。現在は銀行の事務所や美術コレクション、催事に使われる。
d_en: Ernst Ziller designed this post office, completed in 1874. Restored in 1979, it now houses bank offices and the bank’s art collection and hosts public events.
rn: 改修完了年: 1979。元の設計者: Ernst Ziller。修復担当建築家は出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Restoration completed in 1979. Original architect: Ernst Ziller. The cited source does not name the restoration architect.
d_it: Ernst Ziller progettò questo ufficio postale, completato nel 1874. Restaurato nel 1979, oggi ospita uffici bancari e la collezione d'arte della banca, oltre a eventi pubblici.

d: 20世紀前半の折衷主義建築を2022年に改修し、現在はホスピタリティ分野の教育アカデミーとして使用。Open House Athensの2026年公開案内にも掲載される。
d_en: Renovated in 2022, this eclectic building on 28is Oktovriou Street now houses a hospitality training academy.
rn: 改修完了年: 2022。元建物は1900–1940年頃の折衷主義建築。原設計者・改修設計者は出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Renovation completed in 2022. The original building dates from 1900–1940 and is eclectic. Neither architect is stated in the cited source.
d_it: Ristrutturato nel 2022, questo edificio eclettico in via 28is Oktovriou ospita oggi un'accademia di formazione per l'ospitalità.

d: 20世紀初頭の新古典主義建築を1991年に図書館へ転用。Open House Athensは原設計をAnastasios Metaxas、転用設計をVasilis Tsegkisと記録している。
d_en: Anastasios Metaxas designed this early 20th-century neoclassical building. Vasilis Tsegkis converted it into the Onassis Foundation Library in 1991.
rn: 1991年の図書館転用設計: Vasilis Tsegkis。元の建築設計: Anastasios Metaxas。
rn_en: Library conversion design in 1991: Vasilis Tsegkis. Original building design: Anastasios Metaxas.
k: Onassis Foundation Library; Onasseios Library; Ωνάσειος Βιβλιοθήκη
d_it: Anastasios Metaxas progettò questo edificio neoclassico dell'inizio del Novecento. Vasilis Tsegkis lo trasformò nel 1991 nella Biblioteca della Fondazione Onassis.

d: ニコラオス・ズンブリディス設計で1931年に建設され、1965–1968年に上層が増築された旧証券取引所。現在は催事場として使われ、全面修復が予定されている。
d_en: Built in 1931 to Nikolaos Zoumboulidis’s design, the former Athens Stock Exchange now hosts events. A full restoration is planned.
k: Old Athens Stock Exchange; Παλαιό Χρηματιστήριο Αθηνών
d_it: Costruita nel 1931 su progetto di Nikolaos Zoumboulidis, l'ex Borsa di Atene ospita oggi eventi. È previsto un restauro completo.

addr: 21 Tilemachou Street, Side Street 1, Palaio Faliro, Greece
d: 1950年代の一戸建て住宅をAnna Delgiadoが2025年に改修。初期アテネ・モダニズムの特徴を残しつつ、テラコッタの透過性外壁で日差しと視線を調整している。
d_en: Architect Anna Delgiado renovated this 1950s Athens house in 2025 with Olga Kuzmina assisting. The design retains its early modernist character.
rn: 改修設計: Anna Delgiado (Architectural Bureau 11)、協力: Olga Kuzmina。元建物は1950年代築。
rn_en: Renovation design: Anna Delgiado (Architectural Bureau 11), assisted by Olga Kuzmina. Original house dates from the 1950s.
d_it: L'architetta Anna Delgiado ha ristrutturato nel 2025 questa casa ateniese degli anni Cinquanta, con l'assistenza di Olga Kuzmina. Il progetto conserva il suo carattere proto-modernista.

d: 若い女性の教育協会SENの旧織物工場群は、ニコラオス・リシッポスの設計で1878–1901年に建設。現在は産業時代の織機具を展示し、公開見学にも使われる。
d_en: Designed by Nikolaos Lysippos and built from 1878 to 1901, the former SEN textile factory displays a collection of pre-industrial weaving tools.
k: Historical Textile Factory; Historical Textile Factory of SEN; Ιστορικό Υφαντουργείο ΣΕΝ
d_it: Progettata da Nikolaos Lysippos e costruita tra il 1878 e il 1901, l'ex fabbrica tessile SEN espone una collezione di attrezzi per la tessitura preindustriale.

n: Former Public Tobacco Factory (Hellenic Parliament Library)
d: 1930年竣工の旧公共たばこ工場は、2021年に一部を図書館・文化拠点として修復再整備。現在は議会図書館の部門が入り、文化催事の会場にも使われる。
d_en: Built in 1930, this tobacco factory was refurbished in 2021 for cultural use alongside the Parliament Library, retaining its industrial character.
rn: 修復・再整備完了年: 2021。原設計: Pavlos Athanasakis / Antonis Ligdopoulos (civil engineers)。修復設計者は出典に特定なし。
rn_en: Restoration and refurbishment completed in 2021. Original design: Pavlos Athanasakis / Antonis Ligdopoulos (civil engineers). Restoration architect is not identified in the cited source.
k: Former Public Tobacco Factory; Hellenic Parliament Library and Printing House; Δημόσιο Καπνεργοστάσιο
n_el: Πρώην Δημόσιο Καπνεργοστάσιο – Βιβλιοθήκη και Τυπογραφείο της Βουλής
d_it: Costruita nel 1930, questa fabbrica di tabacco è stata ristrutturata nel 2021 per uso culturale accanto alla Biblioteca del Parlamento, mantenendo il suo carattere industriale.

d: 1970年の建築設計競技で選ばれたプラトン・マッセロスらの本社ビルを2024年に改修。現在は約4,200人が働くOTE本社で、改修設計はA-team Designが担当。
d_en: Selected through a 1970 architectural competition, the OTE headquarters was renovated in 2024 and now provides offices for about 4,200 staff.
rn: 改修設計: A-team Design Ltd. 元設計: Platon Masselos / Grigoris Mavrommatis / Dimitris Nakos (national architectural competition, 1970)。
rn_en: Renovation design: A-team Design Ltd. Original design: Platon Masselos / Grigoris Mavrommatis / Dimitris Nakos (national competition, 1970).
k: OTE HQ; OTE Administrative Building; Διοικητικό Μέγαρο ΟΤΕ
d_it: Selezionata con un concorso di architettura del 1970, la sede dell'OTE è stata ristrutturata nel 2024 e offre oggi uffici per circa 4.200 dipendenti.

n: UNIC Athens Main Building (former Olympic Airways Data Centre)
d: 旧オリンピック航空のデータセンター兼オフィスを大学施設へ転用。buerger katsota architectsが設計し、2025年11月に完成。現在はニコシア大学アテネ校の医学部などが使用する。
d_en: This former Olympic Airways data centre became the UNIC Athens campus in 2025. Buerger Katsota Architects adapted it for medical education and research.
rn: 転用設計: buerger katsota architects。旧建物は1980年代のOlympic Airwaysデータセンター兼オフィス。原設計者は出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Conversion design: buerger katsota architects. The former building was a 1980s Olympic Airways data centre and office; its original architect is not stated.
k: University of Nicosia Athens Campus; UNIC Athens; Πανεπιστήμιο Λευκωσίας Αθήνας
d_it: Questo ex centro dati di Olympic Airways è diventato nel 2025 il campus UNIC Athens. Buerger Katsota Architects lo hanno adattato alla formazione e alla ricerca in ambito medico.

d: 20世紀初頭の新古典主義建築を2020年にKois Associated Architectsが改修し、Gagosianのアテネ・ギャラリーとして整備。ギャラリーは現在も展覧会を開催している。
d_en: Kois Associated Architects renovated this early 20th-century neoclassical building in 2020 for Gagosian. The Athens gallery continues to present exhibitions.
rn: 改修建築家: Kois Associated Architects。元の設計者・改修完了年以外の工事範囲は出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Renovation architect: Kois Associated Architects. The source does not identify the original architect or further scope of works.
d_it: Kois Associated Architects hanno ristrutturato nel 2020 per Gagosian questo edificio neoclassico dell'inizio del Novecento. La galleria di Atene continua a presentare mostre.

n: Church of Greece Cultural Center (Former 401 Military Hospital)
a: Antonis Touloumis / Nikos Dourampeis / Panoraia Kaprinioti (renovation)
d: 旧401軍事病院の石造建物3棟を修復・転用した文化施設。トゥルーミス、ドゥランベイス、カプリニオティが設計し、2024年に完成。現在は教会史料館、図書館、展示・催事空間を備える。
d_en: Three hospital buildings were restored as a cultural centre in 2024. The complex now houses the Church of Greece archive, a library, and exhibition spaces.
rn: 改修完了年: 2024。修復・転用設計: Antonis Touloumis / Nikos Dourampeis / Panoraia Kaprinioti。元の軍事施設の設計者・竣工年は出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Restoration and adaptive reuse completed in 2024 by Antonis Touloumis, Nikos Dourampeis and Panoraia Kaprinioti. The source does not state the original designers or completion year.
k: Church of Greece Cultural Center; Former 401 Military Hospital; Κέντρο Πολιτισμού Εκκλησίας της Ελλάδος
d_it: Tre edifici ospedalieri sono stati restaurati nel 2024 come centro culturale. Il complesso ospita oggi l'archivio della Chiesa di Grecia, una biblioteca e spazi espositivi.

d: キフィシアス通り268番地の5階建てオフィス複合施設をAETER Architectsが改修し、2024年に再整備を完了。2025年にはUrban Soul Project設計のStoiximanオフィスが3フロアに入居した。
d_en: Completed in 2024, this five-storey office block at 268 Kifisias Avenue was renovated by AETER Architects. Stoiximan opened three floors of offices in 2025.
rn: 改修完了年: 2024。改修設計: AETER Architects。2025年に入居したStoiximanオフィスのインテリア設計はUrban Soul Project。
rn_en: Renovation completed in 2024 by AETER Architects. Interior design for the Stoiximan offices opened in 2025 was by Urban Soul Project.
k: Kifisias 268 Office Building; Stoiximan Offices Chalandri
d_it: Completato nel 2024, questo edificio per uffici di cinque piani al numero 268 di viale Kifisias è stato ristrutturato da AETER Architects. Stoiximan ha aperto tre piani di uffici nel 2025.

addr: 387 Syngrou Avenue, Palaio Faliro 175 64, Athens, Greece
d: 1966年に開館した財団施設は1999年から改修され、2003年に新デジタル・プラネタリウムなどを開設。現在も一般向けの天文・科学教育プログラムを提供する。
d_en: Opened in 1966, the foundation was refurbished from 1999 and added a digital planetarium in 2003. It still offers public astronomy and science programmes.
rn: 改修完了年: 2003。元の1966年建築設計者: Andreas Kriezis。2003年改修・新プラネタリウム棟の設計者は出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Refurbished in 2003. Original 1966 building architect: Andreas Kriezis. The cited source does not identify the 2003 renovation or planetarium-wing architect.
d_it: Aperta nel 1966, la fondazione è stata ristrutturata dal 1999 e ha aggiunto un planetario digitale nel 2003. Offre ancora programmi pubblici di astronomia e scienze.

d: 1969〜70年築の住宅をMotusが2024〜25年に改修。既存のモダニズムを基調に、ギリシャの批判的地域主義を参照し、陶製スクリーンを内外に設けた。Open House Athens 2026の公開対象。
d_en: Built in 1969–70, this residence was renovated by Motus in 2024–25. Ceramic screens shape its interior and exterior; it featured in Open House Athens 2026.
rn: 改修完了年: 2025。改修設計: Motus – Dimitris Sotiropoulos。原設計者は引用出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Renovation completed in 2025 by Motus – Dimitris Sotiropoulos. The cited source does not state the original architect.
k: Modernist House in Chalandri; Μοντέρνα κατοικία στο Χαλάνδρι
d_it: Costruita nel 1969–70, questa residenza è stata ristrutturata da Motus nel 2024–25. Schermi in ceramica modellano interni ed esterni; ha fatto parte di Open House Athens 2026.

d: 1842年開設の旧市立病院を転用した新古典主義建築。設計にはF. StauffertとE. Schaubertが関わり、1970年代の改修後、現在はアテネ市文化センターとして使われる。
d_en: Opened in 1842 as a municipal hospital, this neoclassical building was adapted as Athens’s municipal cultural centre after restoration in the 1970s.
k: Municipality of Athens Cultural Centre; Elpis Municipal Hospital
d_it: Aperto nel 1842 come ospedale municipale, questo edificio neoclassico è stato adattato a centro culturale municipale di Atene dopo il restauro degli anni Settanta.

d: 7階建てオフィスビルをTsolakis Architectsが再開発し、2023年に完成。動きを感じさせる幾何学的な外観をもち、現在はKPMGのアテネ拠点として使われる。
d_en: Tsolakis Architects redeveloped this seven-storey office building in 2023. Its shifting geometric façade now fronts KPMG’s Athens offices on Syngrou Avenue.
rn: 改修完了年: 2023。再開発設計: Tsolakis Architects。内装設計: Urban Soul Project。元建物の設計者・完成年は出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Redevelopment completed in 2023 by Tsolakis Architects; interiors by Urban Soul Project. The source does not identify the original architect or completion year.
d_it: Tsolakis Architects hanno riqualificato nel 2023 questo edificio per uffici di sette piani. La facciata geometrica mutevole affaccia oggi sugli uffici ateniesi di KPMG in viale Syngrou.

a: PLAN E.E. / Thomas Greve / Michalis Athanasiadis (renovation)
d: Hans Wolff-Grohmann設計の1982年築施設をPLAN E.E.が2020年に改修。現在もドイツ語講座や図書館、文化プログラムを提供するゲーテ・インスティトゥートのアテネ拠点。
d_en: PLAN E.E. renovated this 1982 building in 2020. It remains the Goethe-Institut’s Athens centre, hosting German courses, a library and cultural programming.
rn: 改修完了年: 2020。改修設計: PLAN E.E. (Dr. Thomas Greve / Michalis Athanasiadis)。元の設計: Hans Wolff-Grohmann、1982年。
rn_en: Renovated in 2020 by PLAN E.E. (Dr. Thomas Greve / Michalis Athanasiadis). Original design: Hans Wolff-Grohmann, 1982.
d_it: PLAN E.E. ha ristrutturato nel 2020 questo edificio del 1982. Resta il centro ateniese del Goethe-Institut, con corsi di tedesco, una biblioteca e una programmazione culturale.

addr: 42 Fokionos Negri Street, Kypseli, Athens 113 61, Greece
d: アレクサンドロス・メタクサス設計の近代主義市場。1937年に完成し、現在は社会的企業、展示、ワークショップなどの地域交流拠点として使われる。
d_en: Designed by Alexandros Metaxas, this modernist market was completed in 1937. It now hosts social enterprises, exhibitions, workshops and community events.
k: Municipal Market of Kypseli; Δημοτική Αγορά Κυψέλης
d_it: Progettato da Alexandros Metaxas, questo mercato modernista fu completato nel 1937. Oggi ospita imprese sociali, mostre, laboratori ed eventi comunitari.

n: Architecture Studio Building at 9 Ippokratous Street
d: スタモス・パパダキス設計、1930年完成のアテネ中心部の建物。3階には現在、建築設計事務所ARCHI4Mが入居している。
d_en: Designed by Stamos Papadakis in 1930, this central Athens building accommodates the ARCHI4M architecture office on its third floor.
k: ARCHI4M Office Building; Architecture Studio on Ippokratous Street
d_it: Progettato da Stamos Papadakis nel 1930, questo edificio del centro di Atene ospita al terzo piano lo studio di architettura ARCHI4M.

addr: 36 Patriarchou Ioakeim Street, Kolonaki, Athens 106 75, Greece
d: 1935年にE. Lazaridesが設計した集合住宅をElastic Architectsが2015年にホテルへ改修。現在もコロナキのCOCO-MATホテルとして案内されている。
d_en: E. Lazarides designed this apartment block in 1935. Elastic Architects renovated it in 2015, and it now operates as COCO-MAT Hotel Athens.
rn: 改修完了年: 2015。改修設計: Elastic Architects。元の集合住宅設計: E. Lazarides、1935年。
rn_en: Renovation completed in 2015 by Elastic Architects. Original apartment-block design: E. Lazarides, 1935.
k: Z. Lorentzatou Building; COCO-MAT HOTEL ATHENS; Ξενοδοχείο COCO-MAT ATHENS
d_it: E. Lazarides progettò questo condominio nel 1935. Elastic Architects lo hanno ristrutturato nel 2015 e oggi funziona come COCO-MAT Hotel Athens.

d: 1910年築の保存建築を活用した文書館。館内ではカヴァフィスの書籍や原稿、所蔵品を公開し、現在も研究者と一般来館者を受け入れている。
d_en: This listed 1910 building houses the Cavafy Archive, with manuscripts, books and personal objects on view. The archive welcomes researchers and the public.
k: C. P. Cavafy Archive; Αρχείο Καβάφη
d_it: Questo edificio vincolato del 1910 ospita l'Archivio Cavafy, con manoscritti, libri e oggetti personali in mostra. L'archivio accoglie ricercatori e pubblico.

a: Gavalas Ioannidou Architecture / Studio Andrew Trotter (renovation)
d: 旧食品倉庫を2016〜2021年にロフト、宿泊、イベント空間へ転用。工業的な建物の骨格を活かし、現在は宿泊や撮影、催事などに利用される。
d_en: Gavalas Ioannidou and Studio Andrew Trotter converted this former food warehouse into a loft complex. It now hosts stays and creative events.
rn: 改修・用途転用期間: 2016〜2021年。設計: Gavalas Ioannidou Architecture / Studio Andrew Trotter。元の倉庫の設計者・竣工年は出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Adaptive reuse completed in 2021 by Gavalas Ioannidou Architecture and Studio Andrew Trotter. The original warehouse architect and date are not stated.
d_it: Gavalas Ioannidou e Studio Andrew Trotter hanno trasformato questo ex magazzino alimentare in un complesso di loft. Oggi ospita soggiorni ed eventi creativi.

addr: 10 Tagmatarchou Plessa Street, Kallithea, Athens 176 74, Greece
d: カリテアの海運企業本社として計画され、RS Sparchが設計した2棟の複合施設。2018年に完成し、オフィスや企業博物館、図書館などを備える。
d_en: Completed in 2018, this two-building complex by RS Sparch houses the Angelicoussis Group headquarters, with offices, a corporate museum and library.
d_it: Completato nel 2018, questo complesso di due edifici di RS Sparch ospita la sede dell'Angelicoussis Group, con uffici, un museo aziendale e una biblioteca.

d: Kaizen Gamingの新本社として2023年に完成したオフィスビル。ASPA-KSTとUrban Soul Projectが設計し、Open House Athensの見学対象にもなった。
d_en: Completed in 2023, this office building was designed by ASPA-KST and Urban Soul Project for Kaizen Gaming. The company lists the same Marousi address.
k: Kaizen Gaming Headquarters; Kaizen Gaming Offices
d_it: Completato nel 2023, questo edificio per uffici è stato progettato da ASPA-KST e Urban Soul Project per Kaizen Gaming. L'azienda indica lo stesso indirizzo di Marousi.

d: T. Misiou設計のモダニズム建築で、1995年に完成。現在もヴァカロ美術・デザイン専門学校の校舎として使われ、訪問は予約制で受け付けている。
d_en: Designed by T. Misiou and completed in 1995, this modernist building remains home to Vakalo Art & Design College, which accepts visits by appointment.
k: Vakalo College; Βακαλό Art & Design College
d_it: Progettato da T. Misiou e completato nel 1995, questo edificio modernista è ancora sede del Vakalo Art & Design College, che accetta visite su appuntamento.

d: リサンドロス・カフタンゾグルが1878年に設計した国立工科大学の歴史的校舎。2010年に教職員による改修が行われ、現在は建築学部や図書館が使う。
d_en: Restored in 2010, this NTUA landmark houses its School of Architecture and a branch library. Lysandros Kaftantzoglou designed it in 1878.
rn: 改修完了年: 2010。改修は国立工科大学の教職員が実施。元の設計: Lysandros Kaftantzoglou、設計年1859〜1878年。
rn_en: Renovated in 2010 by NTUA faculty and staff. Original design: Lysandros Kaftantzoglou, 1859–1878.
k: Averof Building; NTUA Patission Complex; Κτίριο Αβέρωφ
d_it: Restaurato nel 2010, questo edificio simbolo dell'NTUA ospita la Scuola di Architettura e una biblioteca succursale. Lysandros Kaftantzoglou lo progettò nel 1878.

addr: Kykladon Street & Kefallinias Street, Athens, Greece
d: アルキメニス・プロヴェレギオスが1955〜1958年に設計・建設した住宅。2009年にディオニシス・ソトヴィキスが修復し、現在は自身のアトリエとして使う。
d_en: Aristomenis Provelengios designed this modern residence in 1955–58. Dionysis Sotovikis restored it in 2009, and it now serves as his atelier.
rn: 改修完了年: 2009。改修建築家: Dionysis Sotovikis。元の設計・建設: Aristomenis Provelengios、1955〜1958年。
rn_en: Renovation completed in 2009 by Dionysis Sotovikis. Original design and construction by Aristomenis Provelengios, 1955–1958.
d_it: Aristomenis Provelengios progettò questa residenza moderna nel 1955–58. Dionysis Sotovikis l'ha restaurata nel 2009 e oggi serve da suo atelier.

d: コンスタンティノス・マクリスの設計により1958年に建てられた福音派教会。現在も礼拝に使われ、アマリアス通り50番地に所在する。
d_en: Designed by Konstantinos Makris and completed in 1958, this church remains an active congregation at 50 Amalias Avenue in central Athens.
k: First Greek Evangelical Church; Greek Evangelical Church of Athens
d_it: Progettata da Konstantinos Makris e completata nel 1958, questa chiesa è una congregazione attiva al numero 50 di viale Amalias, nel centro di Atene.

d: 1958年築の事務所・店舗併用建物を、AVW Architectureが2023年に33室のホテルへ改修。現在もTwinn Downtown Piraeusとして営業している。
d_en: AVW Architecture converted this 1958 mixed-use building into a 33-room boutique hotel in 2023. It now operates as Twinn, Downtown Piraeus.
rn: 改修完了年: 2023。改修設計: AVW Architecture。元建物: 1958年の事務所・店舗併用建築。原設計者は引用出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Renovation completed in 2023 by AVW Architecture. Original building: mixed-use offices and shops, 1958; original architect not stated in the cited source.
d_it: AVW Architecture ha trasformato nel 2023 questo edificio polifunzionale del 1958 in un boutique hotel di 33 camere. Oggi funziona come Twinn, Downtown Piraeus.

d: 1930年代のアール・デコ建築をK-Studioが2018年にホテルへ改修。特徴的な曲線の外観を保ち、現在は38室のPerianth Hotelとして営業する。
d_en: K-Studio converted this 1930s Art Deco building into a hotel in 2018, reshaping its interior around the existing curved facade. Perianth remains in operation.
rn: 改修・用途転用年: 2018。改修設計: K-Studio。原建物は1930年代のアール・デコ建築。原設計者は引用出典に記載なし。
rn_en: Renovation and conversion completed in 2018 by K-Studio. The original 1930s Art Deco building’s architect is not identified in the cited source.
d_it: K-Studio ha trasformato nel 2018 questo edificio Art Déco degli anni Trenta in un hotel, ridisegnando gli interni attorno alla facciata curva esistente. Il Perianth è in attività.

addr: 3 Georgiou Souri Street & Filellinon Street, Athens 105 57, Greece
d: 1922年築の保存指定を受けた折衷主義建築を、STOA Studio of Architectureが2018年にホテルへ改修。現在はin[n]Athensとして運営されている。
d_en: STOA Studio of Architecture converted this listed 1922 eclectic building into a hotel in 2018. It continues to operate as in[n]Athens near Syntagma Square.
rn: 改修・用途転用年: 2018。改修設計: STOA Studio of Architecture。元の建物: 1922年築の保存指定折衷主義建築。
rn_en: Renovation and conversion completed in 2018 by STOA Studio of Architecture. Original building: listed eclectic building, 1922.
d_it: STOA Studio of Architecture ha trasformato nel 2018 questo edificio eclettico vincolato del 1922 in un hotel. Continua a funzionare come in[n]Athens, vicino a piazza Syntagma.

d: アテナに捧げられたアクロポリスの神殿。紀元前447年に着工し、紀元前438年に完成した。ペルシア戦争の勝利への感謝として建てられた。
d_en: A temple of Athena on the Acropolis, begun in 447 BC and completed in 438 BC in thanksgiving for the victory over the Persian invaders.
d_it: Tempio di Atena sull'Acropoli, iniziato nel 447 a.C. e completato nel 438 a.C. in ringraziamento per la vittoria sugli invasori persiani.

d: アクロポリス北側のイオニア式神殿。アテナ・ポリアスの像を収めた。非対称で複雑な平面が、古典期の神殿としては例外的である。
d_en: An Ionic temple on the north side of the Acropolis that housed the statue of Athena Polias. Its asymmetrical plan is unique among Greek temples.
k: Erechtheum; Temple of Athena Polias; Ερέχθειο
d_it: Tempio ionico sul lato nord dell'Acropoli che ospitava la statua di Atena Polias. La pianta asimmetrica è unica tra i templi greci.

d: アクロポリスの記念的な入口となるドーリア式の門。紀元前437〜432年に、ペリクレスの建築計画の一部として建てられ、未完のまま残った。
d_en: The Doric monumental gateway to the Acropolis, built between 437 and 432 BC as part of the Periklean building programme and left unfinished.
d_it: Monumentale ingresso dorico all'Acropoli, costruito tra il 437 e il 432 a.C. nell'ambito del programma edilizio periclea e rimasto incompiuto.

d: アクロポリスで最小の神殿。紀元前420年頃の建設で、アクロポリス最初の完全なイオニア式神殿とされる。プロピュライアの右手の突出部に建つ。
d_en: The smallest temple on the Acropolis, built around 420 BC. It is regarded as the earliest fully Ionic temple on the Acropolis.
d_it: Il più piccolo tempio dell'Acropoli, costruito intorno al 420 a.C. È considerato il più antico tempio interamente ionico dell'Acropoli.

d: アクロポリス南斜面のディオニュソス聖域にある古代劇場。紀元前6世紀半ば以降に整えられ、紀元前4世紀のリュクルゴスの時期に最大規模(最大約2万5千人)となった。
d_en: An ancient theatre on the south slope of the Acropolis. It reached its fullest extent in the 4th century BC under Lycurgus, with a capacity of up to 25,000.
k: Theater of Dionysos; Θέατρο του Διονύσου
d_it: Antico teatro sul pendio meridionale dell'Acropoli. Raggiunse la massima estensione nel IV secolo a.C. con Licurgo, con una capienza fino a 25.000 spettatori.

d: アクロポリス南東麓の音楽堂。ペリクレスが紀元前435年に、パナテナイア祭の音楽競技や合唱の稽古のために建てた。現存する遺構はわずか。
d_en: A large odeon at the south-east foot of the Acropolis, first built in 435 BC by Pericles for the musical contests of the Panathenaea. Few remains survive.
k: Odeon of Athens; Ωδείον του Περικλέους
d_it: Grande odeon ai piedi sud-orientali dell'Acropoli, costruito per la prima volta nel 435 a.C. da Pericle per le gare musicali delle Panatenee. Ne restano poche tracce.

d: アクロポリス南斜面、ディオニュソス劇場の西にあった医神アスクレピオスと女神ヒュギエイアの聖域。紀元前419〜418年に創設され、6世紀にキリスト教の教会となった。
d_en: A sanctuary of Asclepius and Hygieia on the south slope of the Acropolis, founded in 419–418 BC and later converted into a Christian church in the 6th century.
d_it: Santuario di Asclepio e Igea sul pendio meridionale dell'Acropoli, fondato nel 419–418 a.C. e trasformato in chiesa cristiana nel VI secolo.

d: アクロポリス南斜面、ディオニュソス劇場とヘロデス・アッティクス音楽堂の間にあったヘレニズム期の列柱廊。ペルガモン王エウメネス2世が紀元前160年頃にアテネへ寄贈した。
d_en: A Hellenistic colonnade on the south slope of the Acropolis between the Theatre of Dionysus and the Odeon of Herodes Atticus, donated by Eumenes II of Pergamon around 160 BC.
d_it: Portico ellenistico sul pendio meridionale dell'Acropoli, tra il Teatro di Dioniso e l'Odeon di Erode Attico, donato da Eumene II di Pergamo intorno al 160 a.C.

d: 合唱競演の勝利を記念し、コレゴスのリュシクラテスが紀元前335/334年に建てた円形の記念碑。外観にコリント式を用いたギリシャ最初の建築とされる。
d_en: A circular monument erected by the choregos Lysicrates to commemorate his victory in the dithyramb contest of 335/334 BC. It is the first Greek monument built in the Corinthian order on its exterior.
d_it: Monumento circolare eretto dal corego Lisicrate per commemorare la vittoria nella gara di ditirambo del 335/334 a.C. È il primo monumento greco con l'ordine corinzio all'esterno.

d: アクロポリス南面の洞窟の前に、紀元前320〜319年に建てられたコレゴスのスラシュロスの記念建築。小神殿の形をとり、紀元前271〜270年に改修された。
d_en: A memorial built in 320–319 BC for the choregos Thrasyllos in front of a cave on the south face of the Acropolis, in the form of a small temple. It was modified in 271–270 BC.
d_it: Monumento costruito nel 320–319 a.C. per il corego Trasillo davanti a una grotta sul lato sud dell'Acropoli, a forma di piccolo tempio. Fu modificato nel 271–270 a.C.

d: アクロポリス南西斜面の石造劇場。弁論家ヘロデス・アッティクスが亡き妻を偲んで紀元後161年に建て、市へ贈った。客席と舞台は1950年代にペンテリコン大理石で修復された。
d_en: A stone theatre on the south-west slope of the Acropolis, built in AD 161 by Herodes Atticus in memory of his wife. Its seating and stage were restored in Pentelic marble in the 1950s.
k: Herodeion; Ηρώδειο; Ωδείο Ηρώδου του Αττικού
d_it: Teatro in pietra sul pendio sud-occidentale dell'Acropoli, costruito nel 161 d.C. da Erode Attico in memoria della moglie. Gradinate e scena furono restaurate in marmo pentelico negli anni Cinquanta.

a: Antistates / Callaeschrus / Antimachides / Porinus / Decimus Cossutius
d: ゼウスに捧げられた巨大な神殿。紀元前6世紀に着工し、紀元後2世紀のハドリアヌス帝の時代に完成した(着工から約638年後)。現在は廃墟で、柱の一部が立つ。
d_en: A colossal temple of Zeus begun in the 6th century BC and completed under Emperor Hadrian in the 2nd century AD, about 638 years after the project began. It is now in ruins.
k: Olympieion; Ναός του Ολυμπίου Διός; Columns of Olympian Zeus
d_it: Colossale tempio di Zeus iniziato nel VI secolo a.C. e completato sotto l'imperatore Adriano nel II secolo d.C., circa 638 anni dopo l'inizio del progetto. Oggi è in rovina.

d: ハドリアヌス帝を称えて建てられた記念門。近くの神殿群の奉献(紀元後131年または132年)に合わせて建てられたとする説がある。
d_en: A monumental gateway honouring Emperor Hadrian, proposed to date from the dedication of the nearby temple complex in AD 131 or 132.
k: Hadrian's Gate; Πύλη του Αδριανού; Αψίδα του Αδριανού
d_it: Monumentale arco in onore dell'imperatore Adriano, che si ritiene risalga alla dedicazione del vicino complesso del tempio nel 131 o 132 d.C.

d: ローマ皇帝ハドリアヌスが紀元後132年にアクロポリス北側に建てた図書館の遺構。ローマのフォルムの形式で、入口は一つ、列柱に囲まれた中庭を持つ。
d_en: The ruin of a monumental library built by Emperor Hadrian in AD 132 north of the Acropolis, in the style of a Roman forum with a single entrance and a colonnaded courtyard.
d_it: Rovine di una monumentale biblioteca costruita dall'imperatore Adriano nel 132 d.C. a nord dell'Acropoli, sul modello di un foro romano con un solo ingresso e un cortile porticato.

addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラ南東端にあった図書館。哲学者ティトゥス・フラウィウス・パンタイノスが紀元後98〜102年に建てた。断片的に現存する。
d_en: A library at the south-east end of the Agora of Athens, built by the philosopher Titus Flavius Pantainos between AD 98 and 102. It survives only in fragments.
d_it: Biblioteca all'estremità sud-orientale dell'Agorà di Atene, costruita dal filosofo Tito Flavio Pantainos tra il 98 e il 102 d.C. Sopravvive solo in frammenti.

addr: Pelopida & Aiolou Streets, Plaka, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラの東に造られたローマ期の広場。ユリウス・カエサルの約束に基づき、アウグストゥスの寄進で、紀元前27〜17年頃(紀元前10年とする説もある)に建設された。
d_en: A ruined agora east of the Ancient Agora, built with funds from Augustus between about 27 and 17 BC (possibly 10 BC), fulfilling a promise made by Julius Caesar.
k: Roman Forum of Athens; Ρωμαϊκή Αγορά
d_it: Agorà in rovina a est dell'Agorà antica, costruita con fondi di Augusto tra il 27 e il 17 a.C. circa (forse il 10 a.C.), in adempimento di una promessa di Giulio Cesare.

d: ローマン・アゴラの西側の門。ユリウス・カエサルとアウグストゥスの寄進で紀元前11年に建てられた。ペンテリコン大理石の4本のドーリア式柱で梁を支える。
d_en: The west gate of the Roman Agora, built in 11 BC with donations from Julius Caesar and Augustus. Four Doric columns of Pentelic marble carry its architrave.
k: Roman Agora gate; Πύλη της Αρχηγέτιδος Αθηνάς
d_it: Porta occidentale dell'Agorà romana, costruita nell'11 a.C. con donazioni di Giulio Cesare e Augusto. Quattro colonne doriche di marmo pentelico sostengono l'architrave.

d: ローマン・アゴラにある八角形の塔。遅くとも紀元前50年頃までに完成した。設計者はキュロスのアンドロニコスとされる。
d_en: An octagonal tower in the Roman Agora, completed by about 50 BC at the latest. Its designer is thought to be Andronikos of Kyrrhos.
d_it: Torre ottagonale nell'Agorà romana, completata al più tardi intorno al 50 a.C. Si ritiene che il progettista sia Andronico di Cirro.

d: ムセイオンの丘に建つ、コンマゲネ王家の王子ピロパッポスの記念墓碑。116年の死去を受け、姉のユリア・バルビラとアテネ市民が建てた。
d_en: A Roman mausoleum and monument to the Commagene prince Philopappos, erected by his sister Julia Balbilla and the citizens of Athens after his death in AD 116 on Muses Hill.
d_it: Mausoleo e monumento romano al principe di Commagene Filopappo, eretto dalla sorella Giulia Balbilla e dai cittadini di Atene dopo la sua morte nel 116 d.C. sulla collina delle Muse.

addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: アゴラを見下ろす丘に建つドーリア式神殿で、ほぼ完全な形で残る。着工は紀元前449年。屋根と神像はニキアスの和約(紀元前421〜415年)の間に整った。7世紀から1834年まで教会として使われた。
d_en: A well-preserved Doric temple above the Agora, begun in 449 BC; its roof and cult images were completed during the Peace of Nicias (421–415 BC). It served as a church from the 7th century until 1834.
d_it: Tempio dorico ben conservato sopra l'Agorà, iniziato nel 449 a.C.; il tetto e le immagini di culto furono completati durante la Pace di Nicia (421–415 a.C.). Fu chiesa dal VII secolo al 1834.

addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラ北西隅の二廊式の列柱廊。紀元前425〜410年頃に、ゼウス・エレウテリオスへの信仰のために建てられた。
d_en: A two-aisled stoa in the north-west corner of the Ancient Agora, built about 425–410 BC for the cult of Zeus Eleutherios.
k: Στοά Ελευθερίου Διός; Royal Stoa area
d_it: Portico a due navate nell'angolo nord-occidentale dell'Agorà antica, costruito intorno al 425–410 a.C. per il culto di Zeus Eleuterio.

addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラ北側の彩色柱廊。紀元前460年頃に、キモンの義兄弟ペイシアナクスによって建てられ、のちストア派の名の由来となった。
d_en: The Painted Portico, a Doric stoa on the north side of the Ancient Agora, erected around 460 BC by Peisianax, brother-in-law of Kimon.
d_it: Il Portico Dipinto, una stoà dorica sul lato nord dell'Agorà antica, eretta intorno al 460 a.C. da Pisianatte, cognato di Cimone.

addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラの中央に建てられた大音楽堂。ローマの政治家アグリッパがアテネ市民に贈ったもので、紀元前15年頃の建設とされる。
d_en: A large odeon in the centre of the Ancient Agora, built about 15 BC as a gift from the Roman statesman Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa.
d_it: Grande odeon al centro dell'Agorà antica, costruito intorno al 15 a.C. come dono dello statista romano Marco Vipsanio Agrippa.

addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラにあるアポロン・パトロオスの神殿。紀元前306〜300年頃のイオニア式六柱式で、L字形の珍しい平面を持つ。
d_en: A temple of Apollo in the Ancient Agora. The hexastyle Ionic temple dates from about 306–300 BC and has an unusual L-shaped plan.
d_it: Tempio di Apollo nell'Agorà antica. Il tempio ionico esastilo risale al 306–300 a.C. circa e ha una pianta insolita a forma di L.

d: ケラメイコス地区にあった市壁の主要な門。紀元前478年にテミストクレスの城壁の一部として建てられ、紀元前4世紀に再建された。紀元後3世紀まで使われた。
d_en: The main gate of Athens' city wall at Kerameikos, erected in 478 BC as part of Themistocles' fortifications, rebuilt in the 4th century BC and used until the 3rd century AD.
d_it: Porta principale delle mura di Atene al Ceramico, eretta nel 478 a.C. nell'ambito delle fortificazioni di Temistocle, ricostruita nel IV secolo a.C. e usata fino al III secolo d.C.

d: ローマン・アゴラ北側のモスク。ビザンティン期の教会が1456〜58年にモスクへ転用され、現在の建物は1668〜1670年に建て替えられた。2017年から文化目的で公開されている。
d_en: A mosque on the north side of the Roman Agora. A Byzantine church was converted in 1456/58; the present building replaced it in 1668–1670 and has been open for cultural use since 2017.
d_it: Moschea sul lato nord dell'Agorà romana. Una chiesa bizantina fu convertita nel 1456/58; l'edificio attuale la sostituì nel 1668–1670 ed è aperto a usi culturali dal 2017.

n: Church of the Holy Apostles of Solaki
addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラ内にある中期ビザンティンの教会。10世紀末ごろの建設とされ、2世紀のニンファイオンの跡の上に建つ。
d_en: A Middle Byzantine church in the Ancient Agora, dated to around the late 10th century and built partly over a 2nd-century nymphaion.
k: Agioi Apostoloi Solaki; Άγιοι Απόστολοι Σολάκη
d_it: Chiesa medio-bizantina nell'Agorà antica, datata alla fine del X secolo circa e costruita in parte sopra un ninfeo del II secolo.

d: エルムー通りの中ほどに建つ、11世紀(1050年頃と推定)の中期ビザンティンの教会。古代の女神の神殿跡に建てられたとされる。
d_en: A Middle Byzantine church on Ermou Street, estimated to date from the 11th century, perhaps around 1050, built over an ancient temple of a goddess.
d_it: Chiesa medio-bizantina in via Ermou, che si stima risalga all'XI secolo, forse intorno al 1050, costruita sopra un antico tempio di una dea.

d: アテネ大聖堂の隣に建つ小さな中世の教会。古代の女神エイレイテュイアの神殿跡に建つ。建設時期は9世紀から13世紀まで諸説あり、13世紀初頭とする説が広く知られてきた。
d_en: A small medieval church beside Athens Cathedral, built on the ruins of a temple of Eileithyia. Its date has been proposed anywhere from the 9th to the 13th century.
k: Panagia Gorgoepikoos; Agios Eleftherios; Παναγία Γοργοεπήκοος
n_el: Ναός Θεοτόκου Γοργοεπήκοου και Αγίου Ελευθερίου
d_it: Piccola chiesa medievale accanto alla Cattedrale di Atene, costruita sulle rovine di un tempio di Ilizia. La sua datazione è stata proposta tra il IX e il XIII secolo.

d: モナスティラキ広場にある10世紀の修道院の中心教会(カトリコン)。かつて「大修道院」と呼ばれ、「モナスティラキ(小修道院)」の地名の由来となった。
d_en: The 10th-century katholikon of a vanished monastery on Monastiraki Square, once known as the Great Monastery, which gave the area its name.
k: Pantanassa; Dormition of the Theotokos; Παντάνασσα
d_it: Katholikon del X secolo di un monastero scomparso in piazza Monastiraki, un tempo noto come Grande Monastero, che diede il nome alla zona.

d: テセイオ地区の小さな十字形平面の教会。11世紀後半または12世紀の建設とされ、アテネ型の八角形ドームを持つ。ファサードにクーフィー体風の装飾がある。
d_en: A small cruciform church in Thiseio, estimated to date from the second half of the 11th or the 12th century, with an Athenian dome and Kufic-style decoration on its facades.
k: Holy Archangels Thiseio; Άγιοι Ασώματοι Θησείου
d_it: Piccola chiesa a croce a Thiseio, che si stima risalga alla seconda metà dell'XI o al XII secolo, con una cupola di tipo ateniese e decorazioni di stile cufico sulle facciate.

d: ペトラキ修道院。中心教会(カトリコン)はコンスタンティノープル型の十字形平面で、10世紀に遡る。修道院そのものが文献に現れるのはオスマン期である。
d_en: A monastery whose katholikon, a cross-in-square church of the Constantinopolitan type, dates to the 10th century; the monastery itself is first attested in Ottoman times.
k: Monastery of Agioi Asomatoi Taxiarches; Μονή Πετράκη
d_it: Monastero il cui katholikon, una chiesa a croce inscritta di tipo costantinopolitano, risale al X secolo; il monastero è attestato per la prima volta in epoca ottomana.

d: アテネ北西のハイダリにある11世紀のビザンティン修道院。ホシオス・ルカス修道院、ネア・モニ修道院とともに、中期ビザンティン建築の傑作としてユネスコ世界遺産に登録されている。
d_en: An eleventh-century Byzantine monastery in Chaidari, northwest of central Athens, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a masterpiece of Middle Byzantine architecture.
d_it: Monastero bizantino dell'XI secolo a Chaidari, a nord-ovest del centro di Atene, Patrimonio mondiale dell'UNESCO e capolavoro dell'architettura medio-bizantina.

d: ヒュメットス山北麓の修道院。現存する中心教会(カトリコン)は1100年頃の建設。古代にはアフロディテの聖地だったとされ、5〜6世紀にキリスト教に取り込まれた。
d_en: A monastery on the north side of Mount Hymettus whose surviving katholikon dates to about 1100. The site was probably a cult place of Aphrodite before Christians took it over in the 5th/6th centuries.
d_it: Monastero sul lato nord del monte Imetto, il cui katholikon superstite risale al 1100 circa. Il sito fu probabilmente un luogo di culto di Afrodite prima che i cristiani lo occupassero nel V/VI secolo.

addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラ北西隅にあった小規模なドーリア式のストア。王アルコンの執務所で、宣誓石が置かれた。北壁と西壁の基礎が残る。
d_en: A small Doric stoa in the northwest corner of the Ancient Agora, seat of the King Archon and site of the oath-taking stone. Part of its north wall and the west wall foundations survive.
k: Royal Stoa; Stoa of the King Archon; Στοά του Βασιλέως
d_it: Piccola stoà dorica nell'angolo nord-occidentale dell'Agorà antica, sede dell'arconte re e luogo della pietra del giuramento. Restano parte del muro nord e le fondazioni del muro ovest.

addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラにあった大理石の台座。アテネの十部族の名祖となる英雄たちの青銅像を載せ、公示板としても使われた。現存するのは台座の基礎部分。
d_en: A marble podium in the Ancient Agora that carried bronze statues of the heroes who gave their names to the ten Athenian tribes. It also served as a public notice board; the surviving base dates to the mid-4th century BC.
k: Eponymous Heroes; Μνημείο των Επωνύμων Ηρώων; Agora notice board
d_it: Podio di marmo nell'Agorà antica che sosteneva le statue di bronzo degli eroi eponimi delle dieci tribù ateniesi. Serviva anche da bacheca pubblica; la base superstite risale alla metà del IV secolo a.C.

addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラ西側にあった旧評議会議場。新議場の建設後、母神(キュベレ)の神殿に転用され、市の公文書も保管した。
d_en: The Old Bouleuterion on the west side of the Ancient Agora, where the city council met. After the New Bouleuterion was built, it became a temple of the Mother of the Gods and also housed the city archives.
k: Metroon; Old Bouleuterion; Μητρῷον; Temple of the Mother of the Gods
d_it: Il Vecchio Buleuterio sul lato occidentale dell'Agorà antica, dove si riuniva il consiglio cittadino. Dopo la costruzione del Nuovo Buleuterio divenne tempio della Madre degli Dei e ospitò anche gli archivi della città.

d: アクロポリス西方の丘にあった民会(エクレシア)の会場。弁論壇(ベーマ)と半円形の聴衆席を持ち、前5世紀から前4世紀にかけて三段階で整備された。
d_en: The hillside meeting place of the Athenian popular assembly west of the Acropolis, with a speaker's platform (bema) and a semicircular auditorium. It was rebuilt in three phases between the 5th and 4th centuries BC.
d_it: Luogo di riunione sulla collina dell'assemblea popolare ateniese a ovest dell'Acropoli, con una tribuna per gli oratori (bema) e un'area semicircolare. Fu ricostruito in tre fasi tra il V e il IV secolo a.C.

addr: Rigillis and Vasilissis Sofias Streets, Athens, Greece
d: アポロン・リュケイオスに捧げられた体育場跡で、アリストテレスの学園があった場所。1996年に体育場とレスリング場の遺構が発掘され、現在は公園として公開されている。
d_en: The site of the gymnasium dedicated to Apollo Lyceus, where Aristotle founded his school. Remains of the gymnasium and wrestling ground were excavated in 1996, and the site is now an open park.
k: Lykeion; Λύκειον; Peripatetic school; Aristotle Lyceum
d_it: Sito del ginnasio dedicato ad Apollo Liceo, dove Aristotele fondò la sua scuola. I resti del ginnasio e della palestra sono stati scavati nel 1996 e il sito è oggi un parco aperto.

d: 古代アテネの陶工地区と墓地の遺跡。ディピュロン門と聖門を持つ市壁が前478年ごろに築かれ、聖なる道沿いに墓碑が並んだ。
d_en: The ancient potters' quarter and cemetery of Athens. The city wall with the Dipylon and Sacred Gates was built around 478 BC, and funerary monuments lined the Sacred Way.
k: Ceramicus; Κεραμεικός; Sacred Gate; Street of the Tombs
d_it: L'antico quartiere dei vasai e necropoli di Atene. Le mura con le porte Dipylon e Sacra furono costruite intorno al 478 a.C., e monumenti funerari fiancheggiavano la Via Sacra.

d: アテネ中心部にある11世紀のビザンティン教会。
d_en: A Byzantine church in central Athens, dated to the 11th century.
k: Agii Theodori; Agioi Theodoroi Athens; Ναός Αγίων Θεοδώρων
d_it: Chiesa bizantina nel centro di Atene, datata all'XI secolo.

addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラ西側で、旧議場(Metroon)の西に建てられた新しい評議会議場。旧議場は母神の神殿に転用された。
d_en: The new council chamber built in the Ancient Agora, west of the Old Bouleuterion, which was then converted into a temple of the Mother of the Gods.
k: Bouleuterion; Νέο Βουλευτήριο; Athenian council house
d_it: La nuova sala del consiglio costruita nell'Agorà antica, a ovest del Vecchio Buleuterio, che fu poi trasformato in tempio della Madre degli Dei.

addr: Ancient Agora of Athens, Athens, Greece
d: 古代アゴラ北部にあるドーリア式の周柱式神殿。もとはパラネ(アテネ郊外)のアテナ神殿として建てられ、アウグストゥス期にアゴラへ移築されてアレスに献じられた。
d_en: A Doric peripteral temple in the northern Ancient Agora. Originally built at Pallene for Athena Pallenis, it was moved to the Agora under Augustus and rededicated to Ares.
k: Athena Pallenis; Ναός του Άρη; Temple of Athena Pallenis
d_it: Tempio dorico periptero nella parte settentrionale dell'Agorà antica. Costruito originariamente a Pallene per Atena Pallenide, fu trasferito nell'Agorà sotto Augusto e dedicato di nuovo ad Ares.
